verdict.summary_en: Order acknowledgement OA26433970 from Boise Semiconductor Inc. to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318690 (2026-07-06). It confirms two lines of CMP-GAM-002 (Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5) at 6.11 USD each: 10,000 pcs for 2026-08-07 and 9,000 pcs for 2026-08-14 (19,000 total). Terms are EXW Boise, payment NET30. The delivery terms text contradicts itself: EXW, but freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by the Seller and added to the invoice.
red_flags: Delivery terms are internally inconsistent: EXW Boise is stated (and DDP 'not agreed'), but the same paragraph says freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by Seller and added to the invoice. Under EXW the buyer normally arranges and pays freight, so this adds charges to the invoice that EXW would not normally include.
The confirmed quantity is split across two delivery dates (10,000 on 2026-08-07 and 9,000 on 2026-08-14); the ordered quantity is not shown on this document, so it cannot be checked against the PO.
No document date is printed on the acknowledgement.
observations: Clean, typed PDF; no handwriting, stamps, strike-throughs or signatures.
Unit price is shown per piece with no line totals; the unit is not stated for quantities (assumed pieces, not recorded).
The description wraps across lines ('Game Card 64 / GB – Grand / Heist 5') but reads as one description.
